identitySignals: OUSD title names the 'Bay Area Collaborative Fee Agreement (BAC)' for special education, matching the Solano County SELPA page describing the Bay Area Collaborative as a group of member SELPA directors that negotiates rates with nonpublic schools and agencies
No page found that confirms Oakland Unified is a member or that 'Interagency SELPA Directors' is a single legal entity
research.notes: Informal inter-agency body of SELPA directors, not a registered business or nonprofit. It has no website, registry IDs or contact details of its own; the contact details on the Solano County SELPA page belong to that SELPA (chair is a named individual), so none were used. The agenda name 'Interagency SELPA Directors' cannot be tied to one legal entity. Not suitable for publication as an organization profile.

profile.summary: The Bay Area Collaborative is a group of Special Education Local Plan Area (SELPA) directors from Bay Area regions, with one nonpublic agency representative and one nonpublic school representative. It develops an annual master contract and negotiates rates for preferred nonpublic schools and agencies that provide special education services.
